label: Bible Study
prompt: And yet I say unto you, That even Solomon in all his _____ was not arrayed like one of these.
verse: And yet I say unto you, That even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
note: Consider the lilies — Israel's most splendid king couldn't match a wildflower's outfit.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And from Jesus Christ, who is the faithful witness, and the first begotten of the dead, and the prince of the kings of the earth. Unto him that loved us, and washed us from our _____ in his own blood,
verse: And from Jesus Christ, who is the faithful witness, and the first begotten of the dead, and the prince of the kings of the earth. Unto him that loved us, and washed us from our sins in his own blood,
note: John's opening praise: Jesus loved us and washed us from our sins.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And your feet _____ with the preparation of the gospel of peace;
verse: And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace;
note: 'Shod' means wearing shoes — in the armour of God, your footwear is the gospel of peace.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For here have we no _____ city, but we seek one to come.
verse: For here have we no continuing city, but we seek one to come.
note: Readers who'd lost property for their faith are reminded that no earthly city was ever permanent anyway.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a _____ savour.
verse: And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour.
note: Christ's self-giving as 'a sweetsmelling savour' — offering language straight out of Leviticus, in one KJV compound.
